overview_description.description: Layers is a service that lets people consume personalized content curated by their friends or the people they admire on any platform: browser, iOS and Android.  Layers makes getting your friends' updates on social networks a more fluid, visual and enjoyable experience. Get news from your friends -- the links they share, their tweets and more -- in a beautiful flowing stream.  See previews of photos and videos as they were meant to be seen -- instantly and without all the clicking. You can even follow your favorite websites -- from newspapers to blogs -- in a whole new way.  With Layers you can share, discover and interact with everything you care about all in one place.
